from pydantic import BaseModel, Field

class Party(BaseModel):
    name: str = Field(description="Name of the person or organization involved in the case")
    role: str = Field(description="Procedural role of the party (e.g., Appellant, Applicant, Respondent)")

class FeeDetail(BaseModel):
    fee_type: str = Field(description="Type of fee (e.g., '二审案件受理费')")
    amount: str = Field(description="Fee amount (e.g., '22800 元')")
    bearer: str = Field(description="Party responsible for paying the fee")

class JudgmentAction(BaseModel):
    action: str = Field(description="Action taken (e.g., '维持', '撤销', '驳回', '准许撤回')")
    target: str = Field(description="Object of the action (e.g., '一审判决第三项', '再审申请')")

class DocumentInfo(BaseModel):
    document_identifier: str | None = Field(description="The title or reference of the document (e.g., '判决文书1')")
    case_type: str | None = Field(description="Type of the case/judgment (e.g., '民事二审', '行政再审')")
    issuing_court: str | None = Field(description="Court issuing this judgment")
    referenced_case_numbers: list[str] = Field(description="Case numbers cited in the document")
    parties: list[Party] = Field(description="Parties involved and their roles")
    outcome_summary: str | None = Field(description="Overall disposition (e.g., '驳回上诉，维持原判')")
    fee_details: list[FeeDetail] = Field(description="Fee allocation details")
    specific_actions: list[JudgmentAction] = Field(description="Specific items of the judgment decision")

class Parse(BaseModel):
    documents: list[DocumentInfo]
